title: 第二章 可你改变不了你流淌着魔族血脉的事实呢
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“同父异母的妹妹。”

枫溪这话让白玥瞳孔微微收缩起来，她额头上流出少许的汗。

她的瞳孔倒映着枫溪和阿宝的身影。

白玥愣了一下，随后道：“我是白玥。你好，枫溪。”

“这位是？”

白玥的视线落在阿宝那短小的身躯上。

“我同父同母的弟弟，阿宝。”

白玥微微颔首，对着阿宝柔声道：“你好，阿宝。”

对于自己这突然出现的便宜弟弟妹妹，白玥的情感是很复杂的。

她能从他们的身上看到魔神皇枫秀的影子。

“你在喂鱼么？你的脸上有着忧愁呢。”

枫溪注意到她手上的鱼食，不禁挑眉地询问着，“魔族这里让你不开心吗？”

“我认为魔族的环境可比人族那边好太多了。”

魔都心城内充斥着源源不断的黑暗属性灵力。

这股灵力对黑暗属性的魔族来说是很有好处的。

这就是人魔两族的区别。

枫溪身为魔族，当然觉得魔都心城的环境是最适合魔族的。

白玥不习惯，那是她不懂得享受，这就是枫溪的认知。

“的确不开心。”

“圣殿联盟那边有阳光，有温暖，这里看似繁华，实际上全是一片冰冷。哪怕是魔族最繁华的心城也无法跟圣殿联盟的圣城相比！”

白玥反驳着枫溪的话。

因为圣殿联盟是她生长的家园，是她的故土，是她认为最温暖的地方。

比起冷冰冰看似繁华透着无尽寂灭的魔都心城，那当然是圣殿联盟更让白玥在意。

她被迫来到这个满是黑暗灵力的地方，心中自然充斥着不甘。

可再有太多的不甘，她也没有力量来改变现状。

因为她没有办法修炼，这是白玥最大的遗憾。

“阳光么？呵呵。”

枫溪的唇角微微上扬着，蓝眸中是淡淡的笑意，“可魔族最不需要的就是光明啊！”

“生活在黑暗之中的种族，注定不可能拥有光明和温暖的。”

“无论你多么向往阳光，你体内流淌着的是终究是冰冷的魔族之血啊。”

“我亲爱的姐姐。”

枫溪松开阿宝的手，平步走到白玥的面前，跟白玥对视上。

十六岁的枫溪身材高挑，继承了父母优良基因的她容貌出众，再加上从小接受继承人的精英教育，她的气场特别强。

于是，顶着枫溪的气场压力，白玥眼中是惊愕的神情，“你别离我那么近……”

“我有点发怵。”

"Half-sister."

Fengxi's words made Bai Yue's pupils shrink slightly, and a little sweat flowed from her forehead.

Her pupils reflected the figures of Fengxi and Abao.

Bai Yue was stunned for a moment, and then said: "I am Bai Yue. Hello, Fengxi."

"Who is this?"

Bai Yue's eyes fell on Abao's short body.

"My half-brother, Abao."

Bai Yue nodded slightly and said softly to Abao: "Hello, Abao."

Bai Yue's emotions towards her cheap younger brother and sister who suddenly appeared were very complicated.

She could see the shadow of Demon God Emperor Fengxiu in them.

"Are you feeding the fish? There is sadness on your face."

Fengxi noticed the fish food in her hand and couldn't help but raise her eyebrows and asked, "Does the Demon Clan make you unhappy?"

"I think the environment of the Demon Race is much better than that of the Human Race."

The inner city of the magic city is filled with a steady stream of dark spiritual power.

This spiritual power is very beneficial to demons with dark attributes.

This is the difference between humans and demons.

As a demon, Fengxi naturally felt that the environment in the heart of the demon city was the most suitable for demons.

Bai Yue is not used to it because she doesn't know how to enjoy it. This is Fengxi's understanding.

"Really unhappy."

"There is sunshine and warmth over there in the Temple Alliance. It looks prosperous here, but in fact it is all cold. Even the most prosperous Heart City of the Demon Clan cannot compare with the Holy City of the Temple Alliance!"

Bai Yue refuted Fengxi's words.

Because the Temple Alliance is the home where she grew up, her hometown, and the place she thinks is the warmest.

Compared to the seemingly prosperous and endlessly desolate inner city of the Demon City, of course it was the Temple Alliance that concerned Bai Yue more.

She was forced to come to this place full of dark spiritual power, and her heart was naturally filled with unwillingness.

But no matter how unwilling she was, she had no power to change the situation.

Because she has no way to practice, this is Bai Yue's biggest regret.

"Sunshine? Haha."

The corners of Fengxi's lips raised slightly, and there was a faint smile in his blue eyes, "But the last thing the demons need is light!"

"A race living in darkness is destined to be unable to have light and warmth."

"No matter how much you yearn for the sun, what flows in your body is the cold demon blood."

"My dear sister."

Fengxi let go of Abao's hand, walked straight in front of Bai Yue, and looked at Bai Yue.

Sixteen-year-old Fengxi is tall and tall. She has inherited the excellent genes of her parents and has outstanding appearance. In addition, she has received an elite education from an heir since she was a child, which makes her aura particularly strong.

So, against the pressure of Fengxi's aura, Bai Yue's eyes were filled with astonishment, "Don't get so close to me..."

"I'm a little scared."
